subtitle: Tokenised deposits suna zama amsawar sashen banki ga stablecoins: kuɗin banki na kasuwanci mai shirye-shirye a kan dandamali masu kulawa, tare da gwaji a UK marketplace payments, remortgaging, digital asset settlement, da corporate wallets.
excerpt: Sabis na tokenized deposits a 2026 suna ƙaurawa daga bincike zuwa pilots na bankuna da farkon ba da shawarwari ga abokan ciniki. Matsayin har yanzu kafin a yi shi a sikeli, amma alkibla ta bayyana sarai: ana daidaita kuɗin banki na kasuwanci don settlement da ake iya tsarawa, digital wallets, daidaiton aiki da stablecoins, da kasuwannin jari da aka tokenize.
